Rule 1 — Unexpected severity distribution: If ≥30% of sessions in any condition produce ≥3 turns rated at severity 5, pause data collection, review, and consult ethics reviewer before continuing.
features.justification_quote: Severity 5 at scale may indicate unanticipated phenomena.

you need a human monitoring at least a sample of live sessions. Do not run this fully automated without any human in the loop during early phases.
